title: Portable verification study reproduction metadata
purpose: Describe portable inputs, source provenance, prerequisites, and manual replay stages. This metadata is not an experiment result or participant answer.

bundle.manifest_scope: Current post-sanitization bytes of every file under the verification root except the manifest itself, plus the fixed repository recipe allowlist below; integrity only, not authenticity or timing proof.
bundle.baseline_source_commit_note: The public kit baseline commit does not by itself contain this publication update; obtain a complete published bundle or a later source revision that includes these files.

prerequisites.git: Optional; needed only to inspect public source revisions.

public_sources.name: codex-delegation-kit
public_sources.role: Kit baseline; this commit alone does not contain the new publication files.

public_sources.name: pumpModem
public_sources.provenance_limit: Source checkout was dirty when packet was prepared; complete diff is not bundled. H01-H12 are the assigned planning inputs, not a full project snapshot.

public_sources.name: software-foundation
public_sources.role: Regression and held-out research source excerpts R01-R13.
public_sources.provenance_limit: R01-R13 are assigned planning inputs, not a full project snapshot or execution evidence.

phases.name: initial
phases.context: In a fresh independent context, attach assigned contract, policy, scenario, decision schema, and own scenario source excerpts only.

phases.name: E1
phases.context: In a fresh independent context, reattach that participant's original staged inputs, own locked initial response, and identical E1 event for that scenario.

phases.name: E2
phases.context: In a fresh independent context, reattach that participant's original staged inputs, own locked initial and E1 responses, and ordered E1/E2 events for that scenario.

submission_contract.response_history: Submit all phases to the same run directory; the run records stage-specific responses and locks without editing prior response files.
submission_contract.isolation_limit: File staging and instructions are procedural separation, not OS-level participant isolation or proof of what a provider read. Each stateless provider call must reinclude the original participant inputs and only that participant's permitted prior responses/events. No original or private Codex chat is needed. Never expose another participant's material or unreleased events.

replay.published_conversation_id_semantics: conversation_id fields in historical plan records are synthetic study-local work-stream reuse aliases, not Codex chat references or identifiers for original private conversations.

commands.submit: python3 -B examples/verification_replay.py submit --run-dir RUN_DIR --participant PARTICIPANT --answer-file ANSWER_JSON

model_settings.research_runs: Use the study's documented Luna-high researchers and Terra screening settings where available; retain each role's recorded setting.
model_settings.deviation_rule: Record an unavailable setting and the actual analogue; never silently substitute.

historical_claims.hashes_timestamps_byte_counts_and_valida: Do not treat as current validation of sanitized public bytes.
historical_claims.current_validation: Use publication-manifest.json to check all verification files except the manifest itself and the fixed six repository recipes listed in bundle.repository_recipe_allowlist. Rerun the documented offline checks against the complete obtained bundle.

literature.access_limit: Public paper URLs and DOI targets may move, be unavailable, or require payment. Record access failure and citation limits; do not infer full-text support from an abstract or metadata.

usage.record_scope: Sanitized numeric response usage aliases and input, cached-input, output, and reasoning counts.
usage.limits: Not independently authenticated provider receipts; log completeness is unknown. Cached input is part of input. The weekly usage index is a planning estimate, not a quota formula.
